p: morrow: Do not delay the time, but take the opportunity when it is offered.
envy: For the envious are obstinate, and cannot be reconciled.
deceitful: They are flattering and seem friendly.
house in the day of thy: Do not trust any worldly help in the day of your trouble.
A prudent man foreseeth the evil: Read Geneva "Pr 22:3"
early in the morning: Hastily and without cause.
man sharpeneth the countenance of his: One hasty man provokes another to anger.
so the heart of man to: There is no difference between men by nature, only the grace of God makes the difference.
praise: That is, he is either known to be ambitious and glorious, or humble and modest.
lambs are for thy clothing: This declares the great goodness of God towards man, and the diligence that he requires from him for the preservation of his gifts.
